limitations: homepage event missing from historic trace; true offset is not known

actual manual pacing and concurrent I/O/CPU can change operation timing
historical curve window overlap is a hypothesis to verify in first run, not a zero-overlap statement or a runtime guarantee
manual_frontend_end: explicit done marker; Krita process exit is not task_end
